summary.text: Mitzi Epstein is a Democratic member of the Arizona Senate for District 12 and first entered the Arizona Legislature in 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she served six years in the Arizona House of Representatives before being elected to the Senate, and was chosen Senate Democratic Leader for the 2023-2024 term.
The biography describes her as a computer systems analyst who has worked for companies including Olin Brass and Citicorp and owns a small business, Custom Language Training.
